description: This file is a shell script for testing the support of file type changes in a git-p4 integration, including operations like creating files, changing files to symlinks, and reverting symlinks back to regular files.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the p4d server for testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description.

methods.name: test_expect_success SYMLINKS
methods.description: Defines a test case with additional label for symlink operations.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets cleanup actions to execute after tests.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Function to clean up git state after tests.
